findings.title: «unido(s)» reads as "united"
findings.note: Same defect class as PR #1970 T2: *unirse a* takes the person as subject, so a channel chip/label «Unidos» / «No unido» reads 'united' / 'not united', not 'channels you joined'. The suggestion uses «miembro», which matches browse.private_member «Privado · miembro» and the audited T2 fix «Comunidades · miembro de …»; «membresía» is already used in noplan.trial.ask_owner_body.

findings.title: «la unión» in join.error.generic
findings.note: «No se pudo completar la unión» reads 'the union/merger could not be completed'. Use the verb with the reader as subject, as join.error.rate_limited already does («intentos de unirse»).

values.ui.community.join.error.generic: No se pudo completar la unión ahora. No se cambió nada. Inténtalo de nuevo.

suggested.ui.community.join.error.generic: No fue posible unirte ahora. No se cambió nada. Inténtalo de nuevo.

findings.title: plural `many` arm omitted
findings.note: es.md (Plurals) gives the pattern with `many {# de …}`; 425 of 509 shipped es plurals carry it, including ui.teamBridge.replies.count. rail.unread is left alone because its words are adjectival («non lus» / «sin leer»), where `other` already reads correctly. Unreachable for these counts in practice, hence NIT.

findings.note: Mechanical checks at aeecfe4a: key set and order equal English (172); every value parses with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser and has the same argument names/types as English; plural arms present for the locale's CLDR categories; U+2026 ellipsis, never ASCII '...'; no bidi control characters; product names (Radient, Radient Console, Team Bridge, Local Operator Community) and #general byte-intact. All 12 suggested values were parsed the same way. Rendered fit and RTL layout not verified (no browser tool in this lane).

Accepted after reading all 172 values: tú register and infinitive action labels per es.md; neutral vocabulary; « plan Team » / « prueba de Team » match ui.teamBridgeTrial; « Descartar » for Dismiss is the shipped es convention (16/16); ¿…? paired; no space before punctuation.
